desc:
👻 Halloween has arrived in Parenthood! Help the Scientist fix her plasma generator and unlock exclusive event only items!
🍵 Jobs Part 2! New Barista job in the cafe
🪲 Many (many) bug fixes

💖 Adopt and look after your NPC child, take care of their needs and customize their look!
👗 Customize your own avatar for free!
✨ Roleplay as a Parent
🏠 Buy a home and decorate it however you like!

⚠️ Please note that this game has just been released and you may encounter game breaking bugs!

Tags: Life simulation, Roleplay, Town & City
